verdict.rationale: Jira exposes a REST API that users actively use for custom queries (jira-comm-20), and Atlassian also maintains an official MCP server (atlassian-mcp-server) enabling AI-agent access, alongside marketing claims of 'rich APIs' (jira-docs-1). Probes for llms.txt/openapi.json at guessed URLs failed, suggesting docs aren't discoverable via those standard conventions, but the underlying API and MCP tooling clearly exist.
